about_the_game:
You're the Chump that's found yourself dealing with a swarm of horrors. Survive the onslaught and bring an end to their terror.

Ultimate Chump is an action rouge lite where you mix and match your loadout to survive against a swarm of various enemies. Every successful wave provides you with a selection of upgrades to boost your character in a particular way for various builds.

Each game puts you in a randomly generated level in which you'll also find various interactable objects to aid you in your run. From powerful augments that will change how your character, weapons and gear work, to support objects and minions that'll aid your survival.

Each playthrough typically lasts under 30 minutes.

--- Demo Features ---

This demo lets you try typical playthroughs of the base game starting options.

It is limited in that no unlocks are available and there's a smaller pool of possible levels, upgrades and enemies.
